title: Independently recount PR6353 recursive invoices and fixed-saving margin
body:
## Result
Independently derives PR #6353's **complete finite formal recursive-job invoice**, under its declared frame-rank tariff and frozen PR6348 caller interface. Separate span-based and pivot-based implementations agree on all old/new local and complete paid/productive coefficients and all four delta vectors.

All nine target contractions are debited at each of nineteen calls: **171 debit records**, 70,656 paid jobs, 14,214 productive fields, rank-mass surplus808. Local scalar work rises127,088→128,694. At the author's fixed saving315057/100000000, rigorous rational bounds certify new margin>0.00306055749 and same-caller source margin<−0.19287557317.

This resolves a finite billing gate, not native/physical tariff applicability, the caller Laurent endpoint/contacts, erasure, complete ordinary funding, compiler/outer admission, or a newκ. All five framework assumptions and selected6030 remain.

- Six **counterfactual ledger vectors** expose concrete coefficient errors; an inconsistent literal output declaration rejects. These are not claimed as six physical-program mutation replays.
- An independent rational atanh/exponential enclosure proves the one-point signs; no crossing search.
- Read-only Git-free/empty-PATH replay passes; six source-corruption and two typed-receipt controls reject.
- Exact committed bytes/modes, declared source ancestry and self-contained export pass.

[Scope, proof, commands, full receipts and next questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/b0aa576f696596bab37817334f75237410a6204f/research/p104-joint-output-invoice-audit). Hosted CI and human acceptance remain separate.
